description: K₂NaNbO₂F₄ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent K sites. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 3.02-3.09 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.08 Å. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to two O and four F atoms to form NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₂F₄ octahedra and faces with eight KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. There is one shorter (2.39 Å) and one longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond length. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.30 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to two O and four F atoms to form NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₂F₄ octahedra and faces with eight KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. There is one shorter (2.38 Å) and one longer (2.41 Å) Na-O bond length. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.29 Å.
